auth.language.button.comment: Accessibility label of the globe button on the sign-in and sign-up screens.

common.close.comment: Accessibility label of a button that closes a sheet or dialog, e.g. the language list opened from the sign-in screen.

language.name.ar.comment: Name of the Arabic language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.en.comment: Name of the English language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.es.comment: Name of the Spanish language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.fa.comment: Name of the Persian (Farsi) language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.he.comment: Name of the Hebrew language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.hi.comment: Name of the Hindi language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.pt-br.comment: Name of Brazilian Portuguese, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.ru.comment: Name of the Russian language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.tr.comment: Name of the Turkish language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.uk.comment: Name of the Ukrainian language, shown under its own name in the language list.

language.name.zh-hans.comment: Name of Simplified Chinese, shown under its own name in the language list.

settings.about.translations_updated.comment: Settings > About, shown when a signed translation update is active. {date} is a date formatted for the locale.

settings.appearance.theme.comment: Label of the light / dark theme choice.

settings.appearance.theme.system.comment: Theme option: follow the device's light or dark setting.

settings.language.load_failed.text: Couldn't load this language. Check your connection and try again.
settings.language.load_failed.comment: Web only: the language file failed to download; the interface stays in the old language.

settings.language.no_results.comment: Shown when the search matches no language.

settings.language.same_as_system.comment: First row of the language list: follow the device's language.

settings.language.same_as_system_detail.comment: Subtitle form of the first row. {language} is the resolved language written in itself, e.g. 'Deutsch'.

settings.language.search.comment: Placeholder of the search field above the language list.

settings.language.title.comment: Title of the Settings screen that picks the interface language, and of the Settings row that opens it.

settings.section.account.comment: Settings section: sign out, forget this device, delete account.

settings.section.appearance.comment: Settings section: theme and text size.

settings.section.media.comment: Settings section: camera, microphone and media options.
